notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 2.0
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32142043/6459083529ea41161773df3c729dfb2ef12dec04.png[/img]
[h1] The 2nd Open Beta of 'THE DAY Online" Is Opening!	[/h1]
Hello there!
We are very pleased to post the 2nd open beta of "THE DAY Online'
Gettng feedback from many users, we've updated our shortcomings from the 1st open beta.
Still there might be some parts need to be improved but again we are always ready to listen to more from you.
We'd like to thank all of you who are deeply interested in 'THE DAY Online". 


[h1]UPDATE 2.0 [/h1]
[b] Ease Access for Users [/b]
[list]
    [*]Improvement of lobby system :
 'lobby' has been changed into waiting room for users applying for matching.
   Previous lobby will be added into battle practice mode for doing pre-battle practice among other users.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32142043/e104be64640e0f0c3e566528f5556c4ed7e4b516.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32142043/29501e4f9072672942d2b8564a6068a8b81a864b.png[/img]
    [*]Adding personal battle practice room :  
   Champion skills on Bot can be practiced.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32142043/a716cb2ee40aa7dd1cfadbc6c85f73c8ea6248fb.png[/img]
    [*]Adding DownTown Battle tutorial:
   by better understaning objects of downtown map, you can experience destroying AI and winning skills.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32142043/fe4842647d60dcd2303b517b5edb3e7e0020df0b.png[/img]
    [*]Adding DownTown AI battle: 
   user vs. AI added. previous user+AI  vs user+AI removed.
   We hope our new users can familiarize downtown map in easy way.
    [*]Adding character naming: 
   Character names simplyfied, which is one of your continuous feedbacks.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32142043/4c86b3c794e0c3310b5b6ee0a097fb3c5b277ad1.png[/img]
[/list]

[b] Matching Methods  [/b]
[list]
    [*]To improve new users' game adaptability and preventing matching breakingup, only 'Downtown' is operated for now. 
    [*]Matching users with similar level for certain time instead of previous first-come, first-served matching  
[/list]
[b] Champion Rewarding System  [/b]
Several modifications have been made.  
We do apologize our previous users for any inconveniences these might cause and ask for your generous understanding. Thanks in advance.
[list]
    [*]The first given champions are 7.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32142043/6e92e56dc7bc146ae9c3d28bf1f773f19d01c8d5.png[/img]
    [*]Whenever clearing each mode, you can obtain random champion cards.
    [*]After destroying main bot at the battle practice room, 1 champion card can be given at the main page. (once only) 
    [*]When downtown tutorial completed, 1 champion card can be given. (once only)
    [*]When winning downtown AI battle, 1 champion card can be given. (once only)
    [*] Whenever winning downtown normal game, 1 champion card can be given. ( [b]maximum 18 times only[/b])
[/list]
[b] Modifying battlefield numbers  [/b]
[list]
    [*] Only 'DownTown Battle' is opened for new users to famillize our game easily.
   This is also to settle some parts of matching beeakingups 
   'Resources battlefield' and 'survival deathmatch' will be open with more users coming.
[/list]

[b] Game Motivation [/b]
[list]
    [*] information of winning, winning rate, mmr is only exposed to each individual.users coming.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32142043/f7225b70cbc6f2a163c2557f6a4427af3c12fdf8.png[/img]
    [*] adding limited skin and helmet which can be obtained during openbeta period.
[/list]

[b]Again we are very pleased to inform you of our 2nd Open Beta of 'THE DAY Online'. We do appreciate our users for their patience and feedbacks, which make better 'THE DAY Online'. Thanks! [/b]

notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32142043/3307b5c24ff3db94a69d8ffbc8c326dd1c5cce90.png[/img]

We'd like to start our patch news with an honest statement from developers before we get into the patch details.

The responses and result of The Day Online Open Beta was dramatically different from what we expected before we opened our doors. We were quite frankly shocked, as well as lost on how to proceed from that point on. The hurried last patch, which was our desperate attempt to remedy the situation, no doubt caused much confusion among our players.

Coming out of the initial shock, we held numerous and long internal discussions talking about the future of the game as well as what we have to do. And we found what we've lost along the way. When we founded the company, we were determined to make a game 'with our players' when the right time comes. However, the actions we've taken recently were not. We do realize it now.

We might not be able meet to our players' expectations in timely manner since we are a small company with limited resource, but we promise to do our best to hear our players and incorporate it within the game.

Lastly, the biggest mistake we made was to market our game as MOBA without thinking too much about what the genre actually entails. We wanted to create something new and unique, and the end result closely resembled MOBA on the surface, when actual game mechanic didn't. We are deeply sorry for players who felt disappointed expecting a traditional MOBA.

[b] Patch List[/b]
[list]
    [*]Sub-weapon system rolled back to the original system.
    [*]All champions are temporarily unlocked to test champion balances across the board.
    [*]Respawn delay increment value adjusted: 2 seconds for Resource Battle and 3 seconds for Downtown.
    [*]Maximum respawn delay adjusted: 29 seconds for Resource Battle and 39 seconds for Downtown.
    [*]Human male Warrior Skill 1 cooltime changed to 4 seconds from 3 seconds.
    [*]Human female Tanker normal attack distance changed to 14.5 to 16.5.
    [*]Fury male Tanker Skill 1 cooltime changed to 7 seconds from 5 seconds.
    [*]Fury female Tanker Skill 1 cooltime changed to 10 seconds from 7 seconds.
    [*]Fury female Warrior Skill 1 & 2 no longer ignore enemy defense.
    [*]Dominus male Tanker skill 5 defense changed to 300 from 500.
    [*]Dominus female Warrior normal attack distance changed to 14.5 from 16.5.
    [*]Machina Warrior normal attack distance changed to 14.5 from 16.5
    [*]Resource Battle: Fixed a bug where a character gets stuck on a wall.
    [*]Added options to adjust music, effect, character volume.
[/list]
   * The game balance is subjected to change continuously as the test goes on.


Feedback is always welcome

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[*]The sub-weapon system simplified: Sub-weapon system has been changed into single sub-skill system. A sub-skill activates immediately with right mouse click. The purpose of this change is to make the skill mechanism a bit simpler from the current one.

[*]Pace change for Resource Battle: Refinery Level starts with 3 now in stead of one. Although early game for Resource Battle has its own merits, we've decided to tune Resource Battle more into a quick and action packed experience than before.
